configure_distributed_logging: create a _DistributedLogConfigurer and call configure to set up per-rank log files for distributed training
configure_logger_per_rank: use _DistributedLogConfigurer._configure_logger to add a FileHandler with rank-prefixed log format to the logger
configure_aten_logging: use _DistributedLogConfigurer._configure_aten_logging to enable PyTorch ATen C++ logging to a per-rank log file
configure_nccl_logging: use _DistributedLogConfigurer._configure_nccl_logging to set NCCL_DEBUG and NCCL_DEBUG_FILE env vars for per-rank NCCL logs
enable_aten_logging: call _enable_aten_logging with a Path to enable ATen C++ logging output to the specified log file
